title: Your Trainers Are Fine

pre.en: What does Dan offer the audience at the end of his talk?
pre.zh: 讲座最后，Dan 向听众提出了什么？

intro: 这是一篇讲座稿：健身教练 Dan 在一个下雨的周三晚上给大家讲跑步该穿什么鞋，小陈也被妹妹拉来了。讲座开头打招呼、自我介绍，中间给建议，最后一句收尾。读的时候留意给建议的三种说法：should、ought to 和语气更重、带警告的 had better，特别是否定 had better not 的位置。结尾 Dan 自己露了馅。

sentences.en: Evening, everyone, and thanks for coming out on a wet Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 大家晚上好，谢谢各位在这么个下雨的周三出门过来。

sentences.en: I'm Dan, I've been a trainer in Hackney for fifteen years, and Kim is covering for me at the gym tonight.
sentences.zh: 我是 Dan，在哈克尼当了十五年健身教练，今晚健身房那边是 Kim 替我顶班。

sentences.en: I can see some familiar faces.
sentences.zh: 我看到几张熟面孔。

sentences.en: Chen, nice to see you.
sentences.zh: 小陈，你也来了。

sentences.en: Your sister made you come, didn't she?
sentences.zh: 是你妹妹逼你来的吧？

sentences.en: Right, here's the pattern I usually see.
sentences.zh: 好，我常见到的情况是这样的。

sentences.en: Someone decides to get fit in January and spends a hundred and twenty pounds on new running shoes.
sentences.zh: 有人一月份下决心要练身体，花 120 英镑买了双新跑鞋。

sentences.en: They go for a run twice a week, and after three weeks the shoes are back in the box.
sentences.zh: 每周跑两次步，三个星期后，鞋又回盒子里去了。

sentences.en: That's a waste of money, and I've seen it a hundred times.
sentences.zh: 这就是白花钱，这种事我见过上百回了。

sentences.en: So, my advice.
sentences.zh: 所以我的建议是这样。

sentences.en: You should run in what you've already got.
sentences.zh: 你手头有什么鞋，就穿什么跑。

sentences.en: Any trainers are fine for the first month.
sentences.zh: 头一个月，随便哪双运动鞋都行。

sentences.en: You ought to warm up for five minutes first, even if you feel silly walking fast round the park.
sentences.zh: 跑之前应该先热身五分钟，哪怕绕着公园快走会觉得自己有点傻。

sentences.en: And you'd better not buy anything until you've been running twice a week for a month.
sentences.zh: 还有，坚持每周跑两次、跑满一个月之前，最好什么都别买。

sentences.en: Then, if I were you, I'd have a go at one of those free running tests in a sports shop.
sentences.zh: 到那时候，要是我，就去运动用品店试试他们免费的跑步测试。

sentences.en: Shoes only need replacing after about five hundred miles, not after one bad run.
sentences.zh: 鞋大概跑满五百英里才需要换，而不是跑砸一次就换。

sentences.en: Until then, you're still getting your money's worth.
sentences.zh: 在那之前，这双鞋你都还没穿够本。

sentences.en: New ones need a few short runs to break them in.
sentences.zh: 新鞋得先短跑几次，才能穿合脚。

sentences.en: When I started in 1998, I had one pair.
sentences.zh: 我 1998 年开始跑的时候，就一双鞋。

sentences.en: In those days, nobody did running tests — you just ran.
sentences.zh: 那时候没人做什么跑步测试，跑就完了。

sentences.en: What pays off isn't the shoes, it's turning up.
sentences.zh: 真正有回报的不是鞋，而是每次都到场。

sentences.en: Make the most of the light evenings.
sentences.zh: 趁着傍晚天还亮，多出去跑跑。

sentences.en: And find a friend who'll make you go out in the rain.
sentences.zh: 再找个朋友，下雨天也能把你拽出门。

sentences.en: Don't stay up late the night before a run.
sentences.zh: 跑步前一晚别熬夜。

sentences.en: If you join a running club, give yourself a month to settle in.
sentences.zh: 要是加入了跑步俱乐部，给自己一个月慢慢适应。

sentences.en: And if you miss a week, you'll be back to normal in a few days.
sentences.zh: 哪周没跑也没关系，几天就能恢复过来。

sentences.en: Right, that's me.
sentences.zh: 好，我就讲到这儿。

sentences.en: Oh, and if anyone wants a pair of size 10s, bright orange, worn once, see me after.
sentences.zh: 对了，谁想要一双十码的鞋，亮橙色，只穿过一次——会后来找我。

cards.note: 说天气时 a wet day 就是下雨天，英国人很常用。
to do someone's work while they are away
a familiar face 是「熟面孔」；be familiar with sth 是「对…熟悉」。
to go out and run, usually for exercise
cards.tip: 同样的说法：go for a walk / a swim / a drink；不说 go to a run。
cards.example: I go for a run before work when it's not raining.

cards.note: something that is not worth the money you pay for it
cards.tip: 同样可以说 a waste of time（第 35 课）；加强语气用 a complete / total waste of money。
cards.example: The extra warranty was a complete waste of money.

cards.note: to do gentle exercises to get ready for sport
cards.tip: 名词连写：a warm-up；运动后放松是 cool down。
cards.example: Always warm up before you play football.

cards.note: 比 stupid 轻得多，常用来自嘲：I feel a bit silly。
to try to do something, often for the first time
need replacing = need to be replaced，需要被换。
英国路牌和跑步距离常用英里。
to get enough use or value from something you paid for
cards.tip: your 要跟着主语换：we got our money's worth；money's 带撇号 s。
cards.example: We stayed until the end to get our money's worth.

cards.note: to wear new shoes for short periods until they become comfortable
cards.tip: 代词放中间：break them in；break 的过去式 broke，过去分词 broken。
cards.example: Break your new boots in before the walking holiday.

cards.note: at a time in the past
cards.tip: 前面要先提到过去的某个时间，in those days 才有所指。
cards.example: In those days, nobody had a mobile phone.

cards.note: to bring good results after a lot of effort
cards.tip: 过去式写 paid，不写 payed；pay off a loan 是「还清贷款」。
cards.example: All those hours of practice finally paid off.

cards.note: to arrive, often late or when people are not sure you will come
to use or enjoy something as much as possible while you can
cards.tip: 后面接名词：make the most of your time / the weather。
cards.example: Let's make the most of the sunshine and eat outside.

cards.note: 英国夏天晚上九点多天还亮，the light evenings 指这段傍晚天长的日子；反义 dark evenings。
to go to bed much later than usual
cards.tip: stay up 是「不去睡」；别和 get up late（起得晚）混。
cards.example: I stayed up late to watch the match.

cards.zh: （在新地方、新工作）安顿下来；适应
cards.note: to start to feel happy and relaxed in a new home, job or school
to be the way it usually is again after a problem
wear 的过去分词：wear–wore–worn；worn out 是穿破了。
